question: Eight friends, T, Y, R, E, N, H, J, and L, are sitting around a rectangular table, with four at the corners and four in the middle of the longer sides. All of them are facing outside. Y is sitting at one of the corners. E is an immediate neighbor of both Y and R. H is second to the right of E. E is second to the right of N. J is sitting second to the left of T. Who is sitting to the immediate right of H?
solution:
**Given :** 

 
• Eight friends, T, Y, R, E, N, H, J, and L, are sitting around a rectangular table, with four at the corners and four in the middle of the longer sides.
 
• All of them are facing outside.

**Explanation : **

1) Y is sitting at one of the corners.

2) E is an immediate neighbor of both Y and R.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e98ef4ba8ab606c7393f4ce4b709c8dbc8839809cfde8fce08671749346777e2.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bcaac71da8a872f50fdcbd50f2466dffae2e21d7941d38467e73c1a4a1a0c60.png] 

3) H is second to the right of E.

4) E is second to the right of N.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c938584c148c85effc093885f4b1011050c48a61f53eadbed49980ee19aeaa76.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14d1c583be5d580228a1f61de05cf547cfaa1cd0c4588c6b566073597636586e.png] 

5) J is sitting second to the left of T.

As there is no possible position for L in case - (2) therefore this case is eliminated.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2638bdebade066331664849e381a916bdb7d86563b8188229fa09dfe0eda34bc.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement J is sitting to the immediate right of H.

Hence, **"J"** is the correct answer.
